decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.
Condition : 2 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.

Condition : 3 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.
Condition : 4 - The extension hereby permitted shall not be occupied at any time other than for purposes ancillary to the residential use of the dwelling known as 17 Lingwood Gardens.

Condition : 5 - No additional flank windows or other glazed openings shall be formed in the side walls of the extension hereby approved without the prior written consent of the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 6 - Condition 5

 

The area under the overhanging roof in front of the proposed first floor front bedroom in the side extension hereby approved shall not be infilled to create additional floor space and shall remain set back by one metre from the main front wall of the original house.

 

Reason:

 

To ensure a balance between this house and the adjoining property at No 17 Lingwood Gardens and to protect the street scene by avoiding a terracing effect in accordance with adopted Unitary Development Plan Policy ENV-B.1.1 (New Development) and H.6.4 (Extensions and Alterations) and the Residential Extension Guidelines.
description: Retention of a two storey side extension, single storey rear extension and rear roof extension and two front roof lights.
